notes.zh: 一次性大版本更新（迁移版）：更新电源板、灯板、主控和蓝牙模块。App 改用新的控制协议，支持新版智能遥控器和小遥控器配对；马达蓝牙名改为 SW-TM-XXXX。新增转向速度三档、电池电压与类型设置和低电量提示、无操作自动关机（默认关闭）、GPS 模组开机自检和 7 个卫星系统的卫星数、故障码与清除故障。以后的马达更新都需要先装这个版本。
notes.en: One-time major update (migration): new firmware for the power board, light board, main controller and Bluetooth module. The app uses the new control protocol and pairs the new smart remote and the mini remote; the motor's Bluetooth name becomes SW-TM-XXXX. New: three steering speeds, battery voltage and type settings with low-battery prompts, auto power-off when idle (off by default), GPS module self-check and satellites for 7 systems, fault codes with clearing. Future motor updates require this version.

caution.zh: 升级约 15 分钟。期间不要按马达电源键、不要断开电池，手机放在马达旁边、不要离开升级页面。电源板控制整机供电，刷电源板时断电可能需要返厂维修。升级后请重新校准（指南针和转向）。智能遥控器要升级到新版本并重新配对后才能使用。
caution.en: The update takes about 15 minutes. Do not press the motor's power key or disconnect the battery; keep the phone next to the motor and stay on the update page. The power board supplies the whole motor: losing power while it is being updated may require a factory repair. Recalibrate afterwards (compass and steering). The smart remote works again only after it is updated and paired again.

notes.zh: 首个支持蓝牙在线升级的版本（测试版）。
notes.en: First version with Bluetooth online update (test build).
